schema.name: jobtune-endpoint-manifest
schema.purpose: Reference (Render/Express) vs candidate (Workers/Hono) endpoint parity. Compared by scripts/migration/compare-manifests.js.

topLevel.generator: provenance of the manifest (script, parser, git info); informational
topLevel.sanity: ADR-001 measured numbers vs independently derived numbers; informational
topLevel.appMiddleware: ordered app-level (non-router) app.use() layers of app.js; informational
topLevel.endpoints: REQUIRED. Array of endpoint objects in Express registration order (see endpointFields).
topLevel.oddities: derived anomaly report (shadowed / duplicate routes, unresolved chains, ...); informational

endpointFields.id: string. "METHOD /full/path". Not unique if a route is registered twice.
endpointFields.method: REQUIRED string. Upper-case HTTP method (GET POST PUT PATCH DELETE HEAD OPTIONS ALL).
endpointFields.path: REQUIRED string. Full path = mount prefix + route path, starting with "/", no trailing slash (except "/"). Params as ":name" (Hono ":name{regex}" and Express ":name(regex)" accepted).
endpointFields.auth: REQUIRED boolean. true iff authenticateToken is in the effective chain: inline, via a preceding file-level router.use(), or mount/app-level.
endpointFields.admin: boolean (default false). true iff a requireAdmin guard is in the effective chain.
endpointFields.roles: string[] | null (default null). Union of literal args of requireRole(...) guards in the chain, else null.
endpointFields.minTier: number | string | null (default null). Highest numeric literal arg of requirePlan(n) in the chain; null when not plan-gated; a string (source text of the argument) when the argument is not a literal (always accompanied by flag NON_LITERAL_MINTIER).
endpointFields.guards: string[]. Guard middleware in effective order, canonical text, e.g. ["authenticateToken","requirePlan(2)"]. Any middleware whose name matches authenticate*/require*/optionalAuth is a guard.
endpointFields.chain: string[]. All effective middleware labels in order (app-level, mount-level, file-level, route-level) excluding the terminal handler; aliases resolved (auth -> authenticateToken); "<inline>" = anonymous function. Informational (Workers naming will differ).
endpointFields.layers: {app, mount, file, route}: string[] each; chain split by where it was registered. Informational.
endpointFields.handler: string. Label of the terminal handler ("<inline>" for anonymous functions).
endpointFields.routePath: string. Path relative to its router.
endpointFields.mountPrefix: string|null. Absolute prefix of the router this route lives on (null for routes registered directly on app).
endpointFields.mountOrder: number|null. 1-based index of the top-level mount (app.use(prefix, router)) in app.js.
endpointFields.order: number. 1-based global registration order (Express match order).
endpointFields.sourceFile: string. Repo-relative file containing the registration.
endpointFields.line: number. 1-based line of the router.<method>( call.
endpointFields.flags: string[]. Static-analysis notes: NON_LITERAL_MINTIER, PLAN_WITHOUT_AUTH, PLAN_BEFORE_AUTH, MULTIPLE_PLAN_GUARDS, ADMIN_WITHOUT_AUTH, UNRESOLVED_MIDDLEWARE:<label>, LOCAL_GUARD_DEFINITION:<name>, ALIASED_GUARD:<alias>, REQ_USER_WITHOUT_AUTH, DYNAMIC_PATH, COMPLEX_PATH_PATTERN, NON_TOPLEVEL_REGISTRATION, REQUIREPLAN_NOT_CALLED.

schema.keying: Endpoints are paired on METHOD + canonical(path): lower-cased, trailing slash stripped, every :param (any name / regex constraint) replaced with ":". First occurrence wins on duplicates.
schema.workersExtractionHint: Hono exposes app.routes (method, path, handler[]); resolve each handler to a guard name (e.g. by function name or a registry) and emit the same required fields.

generator.note: Derived purely from static analysis of source; no code executed. Output is deterministic for a given source tree.

adrCountingMethodReproduction.hypothesis: ADR numbers = text-search line counts of "requirePlan(" (JSDoc header / section-comment mentions included) per route file, plus the 1 definition line in src/middleware/requirePlan.js; these are NOT real call sites
